question: Identify the top 10 liquor categories in Iowa in 2021 by calculating, for each category, the average of the per-liter retail prices across all sales transactions in that category during 2021. For these top categories, provide their average per-liter retail prices calculated in the same manner for the years 2019, 2020, and 2021.
sql:
WITH top10_2021 AS (
  SELECT 
    category_name,
    AVG(state_bottle_retail / (bottle_volume_ml / 1000.0)) as avg_per_liter_retail_2021
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.iowa_liquor_sales.sales`
  WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM date) = 2021
    AND bottle_volume_ml > 0
  GROUP BY category_name
  ORDER BY avg_per_liter_retail_2021 DESC
  LIMIT 10
),
category_avgs AS (
  SELECT 
    s.category_name,
    AVG(CASE WHEN EXTRACT(YEAR FROM s.date) = 2019 THEN s.state_bottle_retail / (s.bottle_volume_ml / 1000.0) END) as avg_per_liter_retail_2019,
    AVG(CASE WHEN EXTRACT(YEAR FROM s.date) = 2020 THEN s.state_bottle_retail / (s.bottle_volume_ml / 1000.0) END) as avg_per_liter_retail_2020,
    AVG(CASE WHEN EXTRACT(YEAR FROM s.date) = 2021 THEN s.state_bottle_retail / (s.bottle_volume_ml / 1000.0) END) as avg_per_liter_retail_2021
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.iowa_liquor_sales.sales` s
  WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM s.date) IN (2019, 2020, 2021)
    AND s.bottle_volume_ml > 0
  GROUP BY s.category_name
)
SELECT 
  t.category_name,
  c.avg_per_liter_retail_2019,
  c.avg_per_liter_retail_2020,
  c.avg_per_liter_retail_2021
FROM top10_2021 t
JOIN category_avgs c ON t.category_name = c.category_name
ORDER BY c.avg_per_liter_retail_2021 DESC
